pipelines.title: Whole-layer mono decode
pipelines.before: V01 model runs ordinary attention, mHC, experts and collectives; no mono module.
pipelines.after: V09 has persistent FlyDSL K1/K2 for target and DSpark draft layers.
pipelines.body_change: New mono layer/runner/attention/MoE bodies use peer-memory synchronization and in-kernel TP sums. Exact target and draft active messages occur in each V09 endpoint before E2E measurement.
pipelines.fusion: K1 combines the attention seam (slice/gate/norm/MXFP8) and attention front. K2 combines attention back/wo_b peer push, TP sum + FFN seam, MoE and its reduction. Compressor/indexer run between K1 and K2 where required; Engram injection stays outside. This is two principal persistent launches, not one whole-model kernel.
pipelines.guards: This supplemental V01→V09 comparison is TP4/EP1. Decode-only, ≤48 token rows, suitable cache/routing/graph/residency. Initialization/active logs do not establish measurement-phase coverage.
pipelines.language: FlyDSL persistent kernels; Python dispatch

pipelines.title: Ordinary mHC seam: reference to fused Triton producer
pipelines.before: V01 AMD model directly calls mhc_pre_delayed_torch/mhc_post_torch and separate normalization.
pipelines.after: V09 ordinary path calls the AITER delayed post/pre/RMSNorm implementation.
pipelines.body_change: Recovered AITER bodies resolve the earlier API-only uncertainty: a split-K main kernel forms post-mix, gate-projection partials and carried-pre collapse; a reduce kernel forms gates/Sinkhorn and applies normalization.
pipelines.fusion: Two principal Triton launches (_main_kernel + _reduce_kernel), not one. Main/reduce share partials and layer-input buffers. Entry identity-pre preparation can add operations; mono-covered layers bypass this ordinary seam.
pipelines.guards: gfx950, hc_mult=4, supported contiguous BF16 residual/FP32 gates and norm weights; first entry broadcast and ordinary fallback exceptions retained.
pipelines.language: PyTorch/reference operations → two Triton device stages

pipelines.title: MXFP4 indexer producer fusion
pipelines.before: V01 uses its earlier indexer route; logs expose _gluon_fp8_mqa_logits_kernel and generic routing/reduction candidates.
pipelines.after: V09 requests mxfp4 indexer cache and uses k_norm_rope_mxfp4_cache, q_rope_mxfp4_quant and MXFP4 score kernels.
pipelines.body_change: Recovered Triton producers combine K normalization/rotation/packing/cache storage and Q rotation/packing plus weights; scoring remains a separate Gluon kernel.
pipelines.fusion: Fused K and Q producer operations, followed by separate sparse scoring/top-k. Not a single indexer-plus-attention launch. Log name differences identify compilations, not a complete removed/added execution set.
pipelines.guards: Applies to index-source layers using this cache/config. Such work also remains external between mono launches.
pipelines.language: Triton Q/K producers and Gluon sparse-score device kernel

pipelines.title: Ordinary sparse attention output epilogue
pipelines.before: V01 performs sparse decode reduction, standalone inverse RoPE and BF16 wo_a contraction.
pipelines.after: V09 ordinary gfx950 AITER attention supports inverse-RoPE/MXFP8 output epilogue; wo_a consumes the quantized output through a separate grouped BMM.
pipelines.body_change: vLLM passes positions/cos-sin/out_mxfp8 through sparse_mla_fwd -> pa_decode_sparse -> gfx950 Gluon bodies for fp8_ds_mla packed caches. The device epilogue rotates and quantizes completed attention output.
pipelines.fusion: Reduction/inverse-RoPE/MXFP8 output share the selected output epilogue. Split attention still has main and reduce boundaries, and wo_a remains separate. No transfer of this ordinary-path fusion to already mono-covered work.
pipelines.guards: Ordinary or fallback attention, gfx950 and supported fp8_ds_mla cache. Runtime JIT diagnostics and source dispatch are evidence; no per-kernel duration is available.
pipelines.language: Triton baseline → AITER Gluon sparse main/reduce with a separate Triton wo_a BMM

pipelines.title: Tiny-M activation quantization fused into block32 GEMM
pipelines.before: V09 has separate MXFP8 activation quantization and packed/tiled GEMM.
pipelines.after: V11 _block32_packed_quant_kernel loads raw BF16/FP16 activations, calculates per-32 E8M0 scales/e4m3 data in registers and feeds tl.dot_scaled.
pipelines.body_change: Adds quant_in_kernel dispatch and retuned fused-quant tiles while preserving stock K-accumulation structure. Exact HIT logs expose M/N/K, tile and k_pack. Source and logs establish the guarded producer/consumer fusion.
pipelines.fusion: Removes the standalone activation-quant launch and x_q/x_scale global-memory round trip. A separate split-K reducer can still be needed; the whole linear is not always one launch.
pipelines.guards: Raw contiguous BF16/FP16, packed config, 0<M≤8. Client concurrency does not equal M. Most recorded HITs occur before measurement; every pair reports its own phase and shapes.
pipelines.language: Triton, including tl.dot_scaled

pipelines.title: DSpark Markov sampling on gfx950
pipelines.before: V09 uses ordinary sampling; V10 contains a fused helper whose architecture guard admits gfx942 only.
pipelines.after: V11 guard admits gfx950; exact endpoint logs report five steps, vocabulary 129280, rank 256, 505 blocks.
pipelines.body_change: The per-step kernel loads the previous token via prior block maxima, computes Markov bias plus base logits and block Gumbel-max. Final kernel resolves the last token. The info message is emitted after eligibility checks and before launches.
pipelines.fusion: Sampling core uses five per-step kernels plus one final resolver. Base-logit computation, input gathers and scratch initialization are outside this count. There is no single launch covering all five sequential steps.
pipelines.guards: gfx950 --monokernel, at most five request rows, supported sampler/dtypes. All observed first Markov messages precede E2E measurement; they do not prove sustained coverage at higher concurrency.
pipelines.language: Triton sampling core; separate base-logit GEMM

pipelines.title: SWA metadata helper admitted on gfx950
pipelines.before: V09 has no helper; V10 helper is gfx942-gated.
pipelines.after: V11 architecture predicate admits gfx950.
pipelines.body_change: The existing Triton _decode_swa_meta_kernel writes validity, dense window data and ragged indices/indptr directly into graph buffers.
pipelines.fusion: One metadata-core launch replaces the prior validity/window/count/cumsum/compaction/copy sequence described in source. First-use allocation, token-to-request preparation and tile-scheduler work remain outside that core count.
pipelines.guards: --monokernel, pure decode, ≤32 decode token rows, supported causal or DSpark non-causal metadata. No specific HIT message was found; source eligibility only, not measured launch elimination.
pipelines.language: Triton device body; Python architecture/shape guards

pipelines.title: TP2 ratio-2 internal mono tuning
pipelines.before: V09 uses generic persistent K1/K2 scheduling.
pipelines.after: V11 MonoBuild.tuned selects target-only gfx950 TP2 ratio-2 specializations.
pipelines.body_change: Seam reduction/slice work is combined; normalization publication and gates are rescheduled. MoE down stages pipeline loads/MFMA and cooperative shared-expert work. Same two external persistent-launch boundaries.
pipelines.fusion: Internal fusion/scheduling improvements inside K1/K2, not another layer-level launch collapse.
pipelines.guards: TP2 target ratio2 only; excludes TP4, TP8 and draft routing. Generic active logs do not identify which layers instantiated the tuned build.
pipelines.language: FlyDSL

pipelines.title: Ordinary delayed mHC device bodies unchanged
pipelines.before: V09/V10 AITER delayed post/pre/RMSNorm wrapper and two Triton device bodies.
pipelines.after: V11 retains byte-identical wrapper, device file and gfx950 delayed-seam tuning configuration.
pipelines.body_change: Although AITER package versions change, the specific delayed mHC seam files are unchanged. JIT logs may differ because warmup coverage changes; that does not imply a different kernel body.
pipelines.fusion: Existing main+reduce fusion is retained. V11 separate mHC overlap path can replace the producer/consumer scheduling on FULL graphs; the unchanged AITER seam itself is not new fusion.
pipelines.guards: Ordinary/fallback mHC path only; mono bypasses it. The added gfx942-only ASM seam in aiter/ops/mhc.py is not attributed to MI355X.
pipelines.language: Triton, unchanged device bodies

pipelines.title: mHC overlap and Engram gate sharding
pipelines.before: Earlier ordinary model mHC gate work uses caller stream and common Engram implementation.
pipelines.after: V11 adds an ordinary-path Triton post/collapse/norm producer with auxiliary-stream gate work; Engram gate work is TP-sharded.
pipelines.body_change: mHC FULL graph capture creates stream dependencies, and Engram produces partial statistics/value slices, exchanges them, then finishes gating.
pipelines.fusion: mHC post/collapse/norm producer is fused; moving gate work to another stream is overlap, not single-kernel fusion. Engram retains partial-kernel, collective, final-kernel boundaries.
pipelines.guards: gfx950 ordinary/fallback path; mHC ≤128 tokens, hc_mult4, no ubatching and FULL capture (not eager/piecewise). No direct overlap/Engram HIT log was found.
pipelines.language: Triton producers/Engram stages, AITER gate API, separate collective/stream operations

pipelines.title: MXFP4 Q/K producer and score bodies retained
pipelines.before: V09/V10 MXFP4 K-store, Q-RoPE quant and score implementations.
pipelines.after: V11 retains these inspected producer and score files byte-for-byte.
pipelines.body_change: Logs continue to expose _pa_mqa_logits_mxfp4_kernel and _q_rope_mxfp4_quant_kernel, though logging coverage differs. The score source is Gluon even when the generic JIT logger says Triton.
pipelines.fusion: Existing norm/RoPE/quant/cache boundaries remain. No new producer fusion is assigned to a package-version bump.
pipelines.guards: Index-source work; still outside persistent mono launches. JIT warnings are observations of compilation, not every invocation.
pipelines.language: Triton Q/K producers; Gluon score kernel

pipelines.title: Ordinary sparse MLA body/dispatch changes
pipelines.before: Earlier gfx950 sparse main/reduce bodies.
pipelines.after: Later shared Gluon body adds 64-bit row bases, explicit FMA inverse rotation, zero-denominator protection and BF16 gather-layout adjustment.
pipelines.body_change: The fp8_ds_mla route passes through pa_decode_sparse to this shared Gluon body. The new fp8_scalar fast path in sparse_mla.py has separate format guards and is not credited to the packed DSv4 cache.
pipelines.fusion: Existing inverse-RoPE/MXFP8 epilogue remains fused; these changes are body/layout/numerical robustness and dispatch changes, not proof of a new cross-operator fusion. BF16_GATHER tuning applies only when that gather format is selected.
pipelines.guards: Ordinary/fallback sparse attention. Exact _sparse_mla/_sparse_mla_reduce JIT messages identify compiled candidates, not the full serving trace.
pipelines.language: Gluon device bodies; Python launch/format dispatch

pipelines.title: Tiny-M activation quantization fused into block32 GEMM
pipelines.before: V10 already contains the fused tiny-M block32 quant+GEMM path.
pipelines.after: V11 retains the entire rocm_block32_gemm.py file byte-for-byte.
pipelines.body_change: Both TP8 c1 endpoints have 41 HIT log lines with the same set of M/N/K/tile signatures; all are before measurement. These diagnostic line counts are not launch counts.
pipelines.fusion: Existing quant+GEMM fusion is retained; it cannot be claimed as newly introduced fusion for V10→V11.
pipelines.guards: Same tiny-M/packed/contiguous activation guards; no source-level change in this file. Logging once per shape prevents using the HIT count as call frequency.
pipelines.language: Triton, including tl.dot_scaled

pipelines.title: FlyDSL radix top-k body and observed symbol
pipelines.before: V10 one-block radix selector.
pipelines.after: V11 adds a full_rows factory option and updates FlyDSL vector construction APIs.
pipelines.body_change: full_rows uses fixed width instead of row_ends and adds a _full symbol suffix. The TP8 V11 measured-phase log names radix_topk_one_block_decode_short_k512_b256_w64_v0_s0, with no _full suffix, so that new specialization is not credited to this observation.
pipelines.fusion: No new cross-operator fusion established. A later JIT warning is not proof that the earlier endpoint never ran a corresponding cached top-k kernel.
pipelines.guards: TP8 c1 measured-phase JIT at 06:59:58 in the V11 endpoint; consult its exact phase window. Distinguish wrapper symbol and generated device symbol.
